mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (issued by Gibraltar Registrar of the Supreme Court)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Limited Partnership Agreement (constituted deed) — notarized execution pages
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Gibraltar Notary / foreign notary in jurisdiction of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or UK FCDO Consular Legalization for non-Hague jurisdictions
Hague Apostille where required by onboarding bank

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence for PEPs under POCA 2015 s.32 and GFSC AML/CFT Handbook (PEPs, family, close associates); mandatory screening against UN Security Council consolidated sanctions (implemented under UK Sanctions and Anti-Money Laundering Act 2025 extension to Gibraltar), Gibraltar domestic consolidated sanctions list, and EU/UK sanction regimes; bank-level OFAC screening is standard market practice for USD Swift Wire clearing; vendor screening via Refinitiv World-Check / Dow Jones Risk & Compliance or equivalent at formation, at onboarding, and continuous transaction monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Gibraltar Companies Registry / GFSC Registry Search (https://www.gfsc.gi)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Statutory requirement: name must be in Latin script (English language); no statutory transliteration mandate; suffix 'L.P.' or 'Limited Partnership' required; name must not be misleading, offensive, or identical/discernibly similar to an existing registered name; abbreviations permitted per Companies Registry directive.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or Gibraltar licensed registered agent may file a written representation to the Registrar of Companies within 14 days via the Companies Registry; the Registrar must issue a reasoned decision within 28 days; a further administrative appeal lies to the Financial Services Commission Appeals Committee under the Financial Services Act 2019, and thereafter to the Gibraltar Supreme Court by way of judicial review; a fresh name reservation can be re-filed with a revised name without prejudice.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible: virtual office acceptable solely as a statutory registered-office address where a licensed registered agent provides the physical accommodation and mail-forwarding; however, for a carbon-accounting and offset-brokerage business maintaining a pass-through tax profile, the GFSC and paying/correspondent banks require genuine commercial substance in Gibraltar — at minimum a local director/manager, a dedicated e-mail and telephone line, and physical or shared office capacity; unlicensed shell virtual offices materially increase the risk of bank account rejection and of challenge under the Income Tax Act 2010 economic substance rules.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low but credible: GFSC has inspection powers; unannounced on-site visits for low-risk AML tier (ISIC 7020) are rare, estimated at under 5% per annum; risk rises to 10-15% if the partnership books an offshore-style mailbox-only office without local substance, elects a non-resident general partner, or triggers correspondent-bank 'walk-through' due diligence.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Limited Partnerships Act 2016 (Gibraltar), pt. II ss. 3-12 (registration); s. 5A (elective exempted status); Limited Partnerships Regulations 2017 (annual return); Income Tax Act 2010 (Gibraltar) s. 8(2) (fiscally transparent pass-through); Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 (AML/CFT)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Companies House Gibraltar (Registry of Companies), HM Government of Gibraltar, 12-13 Queensway, Gibraltar
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form SLPA-1 — Application for Registration of a Limited Partnership, accompanied by the executed Limited Partnership Deed and the Registered Agent's consent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an Exempted Limited Partnership; no escrow or banked capital mandate. The General Partner must declare aggregate committed capital on Form SLPA-1; transactions exceeding EUR 15,000 require source-of-funds verification under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2015.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Limited Partnership Deed of KY_ELP, as presented to this meeting, be and is hereby ratified, adopted, and directed to be filed with the Companies House Gibraltar. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Partnership be established at the offices of the appointed Registered Agent in Gibraltar, which office shall serve as the statutory address for service of process. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the General Partner hereby appoints (a) a Compliance Officer for Anti-Money-Laundering oversight and (b) an Authorized Signatory to operate banking relationships and execute client audit engagements, both appointments effective immediately. RESOLVED FURTHER, that all formation fees and recurring corporate administration costs be approved for payment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies House Gibraltar — Name Reservation Desk (egov.gibraltar.gov.gi)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a written name-reservation request for 'KY_ELP' with two alternates, specifying the 'Exempted Limited Partnership' suffix; await the statutory name screen against the register of companies and limited partnerships; pay the reservation fee online.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of the General Partner's passport
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refused as misleading or confusingly similar, file written representations with alternate names within 14 days; the Registrar may permit a phonetic or suffix variation without a new fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Limited Partnership Deed with Exempted Status Election
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Notary Public (in-jurisdiction) or apostilled foreign notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The General Partner and limited partners execute the Partnership Deed, adopting the exempted status election under s. 5A; counterpart execution is permitted with notarized signatures; legalize per Hague Convention where the partners are foreign-resident.
required_dossiers: Exempted Status Election letter signed by all partners
Notarized passports and proof of residential address for each partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a notarial certificate is irregular, re-execute and re-notarize corrected signatures within 5 business days; the Registry will accept a corrective addendum rather than re-filing the entire Deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filings — Submission of Form SLPA-1, Deed and Agent Consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Companies House Gibraltar (Registry) — Companies House e-File Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form SLPA-1, a certified copy of the executed Deed, the Registered Agent's signed consent, and the filing fee receipt online; authorize the Registered Agent to act; verify that the exempted election is flagged in the filing.
required_dossiers: Certified true copy of the executed Partnership Deed
AML/KYC declaration of the General Partner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On registry query or information request, respond within 14 days; failure to respond causes deemed withdrawal and a fresh fee on re-submission. Administrative corrections (name spelling, address) are cured by a simple letter rather than a new application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Registration and Exemption Endorsement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, download the Certificate of Registration of the Limited Partnership; confirm the 'Exempted Limited Partnership' endorsement and the registration number; order three certified extracts for banks and counterparties.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Material errors on the certificate are rectified by a written rectification request supported by statutory declaration, without court action; the corrected certificate is usually re-issued within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Formation Governance Activation — Registered Agent, AML Manual, Banking and Statutory Register
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Agent (TPA) in Gibraltar; Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (AML supervision); licensed bank/EMI
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Activate the statutory register of partners and keep it at the registered office; approve the firm's AML/CFT manual and appoint the Compliance Officer; open a USD corporate account; register the business as a consultancy (ISIC 7020) with the Department of Employment; prepare the initial risk assessment under POCA 2015.
required_dossiers: AML/CFT internal policy and risk assessment
Passport and proof of residence of all beneficial owners
Business plan regarding carbon audit and offset brokerage
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If banking onboarding is delayed, engage the procedure for an alternative licensed finance entity (EMI) already pre-approved by the GFSC; the Registry accepts a supplementary statutory declaration to evidence a change in registered office if the initial agent ceases acting.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for ISIC 7020 business-consulting activities in Gibraltar; regulated-activity supervision (if any, for brokerage of recognized carbon credits) would fall under the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Regulated Activity Waiver / Non-Applicability Statement — Management Consultancy (ISIC 7020) does not require a trading license; voluntary ISO 14064-3 greenhouse-gas verification attestation is recommended but not statutorily mandated

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Heritage & Climate Change, HM Government of Gibraltar
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — administrative office-based consultancy with no physical development; no EIA screening required under the Environmental Impact Assessment and Habitats (Gibraltar) Regulations 2020, Schedule 2
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No waste-water, VOC, or discharge thresholds apply to a professional services office; applicable standards are limited to the Environmental Protection Act 2018 office waste segregation and to registering any backup generator fuel storage > 200L with the Department

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety (Premises) Regulations (Gibraltar) — annual fire risk assessment for the registered office; Civil Contingencies Act 2018 workplace emergency plan; Health and Safety at Work Act 2018 (Gibraltar) annual workplace inspection; structural load clearance letter required for any leased office floor

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Commissioner of Income Tax, Income Tax Office, HM Government of Gibraltar (official portal: https://tax.gov.gi; limited partnership registration: Gibraltar Companies House, Registrar of Companies; indirect tax administration: H.M. Gibraltar Customs & Excise Department, Gibraltar Trade Single Window).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Gibraltar Exempted Limited Partnership (ELP) first obtains a registration/reference number from the Gibraltar Registrar of Companies under the Limited Partnerships Act. No separate income-tax file is opened unless the ELP has Gibraltar-source chargeable income or has partners resident in Gibraltar. Where a filing obligation exists, the general/designated partner submits the partnership deed, partner identification and proof of place of business to the Income Tax Office through the online portal, and the Commissioner issues a Gibraltar tax reference number to the ELP and, where applicable, payer codes to resident partners. Where the ELP has no Gibraltar-source income and no Gibraltar-resident partners, no Gibraltar TIN or VAT ID is required. A VAT ID is not available because Gibraltar is outside the UK VAT territory and does not operate a VAT/GST registration regime.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The ELP is treated as tax-transparent by default: the partnership is not itself assessable to Gibraltar income tax, and each partner is assessed on their share of Gibraltar-source income. There is no US-style check-the-box or elective entity classification under Gibraltar law. In appropriate territorial circumstances, partners may elect to attribute chargeable income under the Income Tax (Categories and Rates) rules; hybrid mismatch elections are not provided for under Gibraltar domestic law, but UK hybrid mismatch/CFA transparency rules may apply to UK-resident partners under UK law where the ELP or a partner is treated differently in another jurisdiction.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT/GST/Sales-and-Use Tax regime; Gibraltar applies only customs import duty, excise duties and transitional duties on specified goods.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable for VAT/GST because no such tax exists in Gibraltar. A business importing, removing or handling controlled or excise goods must register with H.M. Gibraltar Customs and obtain a customs/import-export code irrespective of turnover; there is no economic turnover threshold for VAT registration.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. Gibraltar does not operate real-time fiscal clearance, continuous transaction controls, digital stamping, or an API-based e-invoicing clearance platform. Import and export declarations are lodged electronically via the Gibraltar Trade Single Window or by paper at the customs frontier when electronic submission is unavailable. No post-fiscal validation of B2B invoices is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Gibraltar has no VAT, so there is no VAT zero-rating or VAT refund mechanism. For customs purposes, goods being exported from Gibraltar to a destination outside Gibraltar are outside the scope of Gibraltar customs and excise duty, subject to a valid export declaration and physical removal. ESG carbon footprint auditing and offset brokerage services supplied to clients outside Gibraltar are treated as non-Gibraltar-source, offshore services and are outside the income-tax territorial charge when performed from Gibraltar for offshore recipients; no Gibraltar indirect tax is chargeable. Where the same services are supplied to a UK taxable person, UK VAT may apply under the UK reverse charge or normal place-of-supply rules, but this arises under UK VAT law and not under Gibraltar law.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic SAD/goods declaration lodged in the Gibraltar Trade Single Window)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill or CMR consignment note evidencing physical export movement
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT MT103/MT202 records evidencing receipt of export proceeds
Partnership deed and tax-transparency confirmation (beneficial ownership evidence for customs and licensing)
Statement of physical movement or end-use/onward-supply certificate where goods are transiting Gibraltar
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: H.M. Gibraltar Customs and the Commissioner of Income Tax can reopen export declarations, shipping records and partner allocations retrospectively. Fraudulent export declarations, deliberate mis-statements and false claims to duty relief or offshore income status attract civil penalties, including monetary fines calculated by reference to tax or duty lost, interest on underdeclared amounts, forfeiture of goods, and criminal liability upon conviction, with imprisonment for serious customs evasion. In the absence of a VAT regime there is no anticipated retrospective VAT clawback; however, any false representation exploited to obtain a tax-transparency position or customs duty relief may be challenged and clawed back by the Commissioner, together with statutory late-payment interest and penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Government of Gibraltar under the Currency Notes Act 1934, with banking and deposit-taking supervision exercised by the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC); Gibraltar has no statutory central bank and the Bank of England has no direct regulatory authority over Gibraltar-licensed banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Gibraltar pound (GIP) is fixed at parity with GBP. Gibraltar applies no exchange-control restrictions on current or capital account transactions. The ELP may receive non-resident capital contributions, hold multicurrency accounts, and remit profit shares abroad without prior central bank approval. Practical hurdles are limited to bank-level AML/KYC verification, CRS/FATCA classification, and source-of-funds documentation; no withholding or exchange-control permit is required.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender or mandatory conversion ratio exists in Gibraltar. Exporters and service providers may retain receivables in any freely convertible currency through GFSC-licensed banks. Bank reporting obligations remain limited to sanctions screening, suspicious transaction reporting, and tax transparency under CRS/FATCA where applicable.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Offshore digital EMIs are legally constrained: a non-Gibraltar EMI must obtain GFSC authorisation to carry on e-money or payment services in or from Gibraltar, and UK/EU licences do not automatically passport post-Brexit. A regulated fintech EMI may support payment connectivity as a secondary rail, but the primary treasury account and clearing relationship must sit with a GFSC-licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical director attendance is not a statutory requirement; Gibraltar AML/CFT rules allow risk-based remote identity verification through video KYC and electronic ID&V. In practice, for a non-resident ELP, GFSC-licensed banks normally require at least one director/general partner interview by video conference, and may demand a physical meeting or notarised/Certified English-language attestation executed through a Gibraltar registered agent. A local registered office and agent are recommended to reduce onboarding friction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore special-territory ELP with non-resident partners and no statutory minimum capital
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Limited partnership agreement, Gibraltar LP registration certificate, register of partners and beneficial owners, 25%+ ownership breakdown, tax residence and CRS/FATCA self-certifications, source of funds and source of wealth declarations, board minutes approving the banking relationship, economic substance narrative and business plan.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pass-through tax classification creating ambiguity on control and ultimate beneficial ownership
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: General partner agreement, investment management/administration agreements, partnership capital account ledger, UBO escalation evidences, organisational chart, signed AML/KYC questionnaire, partner identification documents, and confirmation of the ELP's non-regulated status under the Financial Services Act 2019.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: ESG carbon audit and offset brokerage model involving unregulated voluntary carbon-market counterparties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Client engagement agreements, carbon registry account statements (e.g., Verra, Gold Standard, UK GHG Registry), verified emission reduction purchase contracts, invoice and payment audit trail, carbon credit retirement records, sanctions/PEP screening of all counterparties, and a compliance memorandum mapping the commercial model to ISIC 7020/NAICS 541620.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low physical substance and expected cross-border wire patterns through multiple jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Substance evidence including lease, local registered agent, staff or subcontractor agreements; 12-to-36 month projected cash flows; counterparty transaction matrix; explanations for all anticipated high-value SWIFT flows; letters of comfort from regulated advisers; and a signed attestation that no crypto-asset or speculative FX activity will be undertaken.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions should be routed by SWIFT MT103 from the investor's or general partner's banking institution to the Gibraltar operational or escrow account. SEPA is not available from Gibraltar, so GBP/USD/EUR funding must use SWIFT, CHAPS, Fedwire, or CHIPS as applicable. In the MT103, the ISO 20022 purpose code 'INTC' (intra-company transfer) should be used where the payer and the ELP are within the same group; if the bank applies IMF/balance-of-payments coding, use the direct-investment equity code, and include the narrative 'Capital Contribution - KY_ELP - INTC'. Banks will verify source of funds, notify the GP of CRS/FATCA reporting obligations, and may require a capital account entry or audit confirmation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational disbursements, carbon-credit purchase settlements, and auditor fees should be paid by SWIFT MT103 through the GFSC-licensed bank. For commercial letter-of-credit settlements, use SWIFT MT700 for LC issuance, MT707 for amendments, and MT754/MT760 as required; final drawing payments are executed by MT103 via the confirming bank. GBP clearing is available through CHAPS and the UK Faster Payments channel via the Gibraltar bank's UK correspondent; EUR could be cleared through SEPA using an EU correspondent account, and USD through CHIPS/Fedwire.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot GBP/EUR/USD transactions with a GFSC-licensed bank or an authorised EU/UK investment firm acting as agent.
Plain-vanilla deliverable forwards under a bilateral ISDA 2002 master agreement with credit support annex, used only to hedge identified non-GBP trade or treasury exposures.
Non-deliverable forwards on illiquid or restricted currencies (e.g., CNY, INR, BRL) via a licensed counterparty, subject to regulatory margin rules and board-approved hedging policy.

Cross-currency swaps for matched long-term liability or asset-currency alignment, permitted when the underlying exposure is non-speculative and consistent with the ELP's commercial carbon-audit and brokerage operations.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return of a Limited Partnership (Form ELP-AR) together with annual confirmation statement
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Gibraltar Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the anniversary of registration of the ELP; for newly registered ELPs, the first annual return is due within 42 days after the first anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 20 per day up to USD 800; persistent non-filing beyond six months exposes the ELP to administrative strike-off from the Register of Limited Partnerships, cessation of legal capacity, and potential personal liability of the general partner for unsatisfied obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Exempted Status Renewal Declaration and Comfort Letter confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Gibraltar Income Tax Office, Exemptions Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June following the end of each calendar tax year; the declaration covers continuing compliance with exempted limited partnership conditions
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic revocation of exempted partnership status with retrospective effect, exposing Gibraltar-source profits to corporate tax at the standard rate of 12.5%; reinstatement requires a fresh application to the Commissioner of Income Tax and payment of a USD 300 restoration fee

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission, Central Beneficial Ownership Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually no later than 31 January for beneficial ownership data as at 31 December preceding; any change in beneficial ownership must be filed within 28 days of the underlying event or transfer of partnership interest
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine up to USD 12,500 per breach plus daily default penalty of USD 600 for continuing non-compliance; repeated default may lead to disqualification of the general partner and removal of the ELP's exempted status

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory audit is compulsory if an ELP exceeds any two of the following three thresholds in a financial year: annual turnover exceeding USD 13 million, balance sheet total exceeding USD 6.5 million, or average number of employees exceeding 50; audit is also compulsory if all general partners are bodies corporate or the ELP is operated as an unregulated collective investment scheme; otherwise, the ELP may elect for audit exemption provided the exempted status declaration includes an audited financial statement if requested by the Registrar
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) with regard to the presentation of fair value information; for carbon audit and brokerage activities, the ELP must also present a separate Measurement, Reporting, and Verification (MRV) schedule under GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, but statutory financial statements remain IFRS-based

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Each calendar year, the general partner must file a UBO Confirmation of Change confirming whether any limited partner has transferred, pledged, or acquired an interest in the ELP during the preceding 12 months. Transfers of partnership interests are not effective for AML and tax reporting purposes until the name of the transferee and the percentage interest are entered in the Register of Members and the Central Beneficial Ownership Register. If a transfer occurs, the general partner must submit a UBO Update Form via a licensed corporate agent no later than 28 days after the transfer, and the annual confirmation must reconcile all registered transfers with the partner register. Failure to confirm a known transfer constitutes a material discrepancy leading to a verification order and potential penalties.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - USD 3,500 per annum for Gibraltar registered office and corporate secretarial agent services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000 - USD 14,000 per annum for certified audit of an ESG carbon accounting and offset brokerage ELP, including IFRS financial statements and GHG Protocol MRV schedule

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays or preferential deduction regimes. The ELP is fiscally transparent; no Gibraltar entity-level tax arises. Non-resident partners are chargeable only on profits arising in or derived from Gibraltar or remitted to Gibraltar, so offshore-source ESG advisory fees generally escape Gibraltar tax. No VAT, no capital gains tax for non-resident partners, and no annual wealth tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Prescribed Gibraltar tax return forms under the Income Tax Act 2010, comprising the Partnership Return and the Corporate Income Tax Return for each corporate partner; submitted to the Comptroller of Income Tax via the Gibraltar Income Tax Office e-portal, with physical filing available at the Income Tax Office, 842 Europort, Gibraltar.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual filing due within 9 months following the end of the accounting period. The Gibraltar year of assessment runs 1 July to 30 June; payments on account follow the self-assessment schedule, with final tax due no later than 9 months after the accounting period end or 31 January following the year of assessment, whichever and as directed by the Comptroller.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ELP identification: name, Companies House Gibraltar limited partnership registration number, registered office address in Gibraltar, and Gibraltar tax reference number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Gibraltar registered office; all foreign-resident partners are separately identified in Box 4 and must not be entered as the filer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting period: commencement and cessation dates, plus audited financial statements reference for the ESG carbon-audit and offset-brokerage trade.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report the full ELP accounting period; no short-period filing is permitted unless the partnership agreement was amended during the year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Chargeable profits: adjusted trading profits under Income Tax Act 2010 sections 16 to 21, after deducting allowable expenses, including staff costs, professional indemnity insurance, software subscriptions for carbon accounting, and carbon-credit inventory costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only profits derived from or remitted to Gibraltar. Exclude foreign-source fees where the non-resident partner performs services wholly outside Gibraltar and has no Gibraltar permanent establishment; attach an apportionment schedule and supporting time records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Partnership allocation schedule: each partner's legal name, country of tax residence, tax identification number, capital contribution, profit-sharing ratio, and allocated profit or loss for the ELP.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Certify that non-resident partners have not exercised management and control in Gibraltar; annex a tax residence certificate (TRC) for each partner claiming treaty benefits and a signed declaration of non-residence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computation: chargeable profits multiplied by the 12.5% corporate rate; foreign tax credit claimed under any applicable double taxation agreement; net tax payable or refund due.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No Gibraltar withholding tax credit is available because Gibraltar imposes zero WHT on distributions. A UK-resident partner claims double tax relief in the UK corporate return using the UK-Gibraltar Double Taxation Agreement 2019.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration and signature: general partner or authorised manager and tax agent declaration of completeness and accuracy, dated and electronically signed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The general partner signs regardless of the partners' residence; foreign signatories may use an accepted digital signature mechanism recognised by the Gibraltar Income Tax Office.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs a fixed penalty of GIP 100 plus a continuing daily default penalty of GIP 50 per day. Late payment attracts statutory interest and a late-payment surcharge of up to 10% of the unpaid tax. An incorrect or incomplete return incurs a penalty of up to 100% of the undercharged tax; fraudulent or negligent evasion attracts a penalty of up to 200% of the evaded tax and criminal prosecution.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (Gibraltar does not impose withholding tax on dividends paid by Gibraltar companies or on profit allocations distributed by an Exempted Limited Partnership to its partners).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Relief is rarely required because Gibraltar source taxation is nil. Where a partner seeks treaty protection (principally under the UK-Gibraltar Double Taxation Agreement 2019, in force January 2021), the partner must: (i) obtain a Gibraltar TRC from the Comptroller of Income Tax, which is issued only after the ELP's substance and filings are verified; (ii) submit the home-state fiscal residence certificate and the Box 4 allocation schedule to the home tax authority; and (iii) claim the foreign tax credit or exemption in the home-country return. For non-UK jurisdictions relying on TIEAs, no dividend relief is applicable but Gibraltar does not tax the distribution.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory: 0% on interest and 0% on royalties paid to non-residents. Treaty: 0% under the UK-Gibraltar DTA; no other comprehensive DTA is in force, but Gibraltar does not assert source WHT. All payments must be at arm's length, beneficially owned, and supported by signed agreements and substance evidence.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory monetary threshold exists for Local File or Master File; the Comptroller may demand transfer pricing documentation for any controlled transaction under Income Tax Act 2010 section 25A. Country-by-Country Reporting applies only to multinational groups with consolidated group revenue of EUR 750,000,000 or more, a threshold the ELP does not meet.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Gibraltar's Economic Substance Regulations 2019, as amended, require entities, including ELPs, conducting relevant activities to maintain adequate premises, full-time employees, and locally incurred operating expenditure. Pure third-party ESG carbon-audit and offset-brokerage services are not a listed relevant activity unless performed for connected affiliates, in which case the service-centre and headquarters categories apply. The ELP must nevertheless maintain a registered office, statutory registers, board minutes, and genuine economic presence in Gibraltar; otherwise the Comptroller may recharacterise profits as Gibraltar-source or impose substance penalties.
